startWithWindows.label: Start with Windows
startWithWindows.help: Open NextLevel automatically when you sign in to Windows.

saveBar.invalid: Fix the highlighted fields to save.

backups.intro: A backup of your settings is made every time you save. The newest 10 are kept.
backups.empty: No backups yet. One is made the next time you save.
backups.confirmText: Restore the backup from {{time}}? Your current settings are backed up first.

data.intro: Where NextLevel keeps its files on this computer.

storage.intro: Folders that contain your systems’ ROM folders. When a game is in several, the first location in this list wins.
storage.empty: No storage locations yet. Add the folders that hold your systems’ ROM folders.
storage.name: Name of location {{n}}

scan.title: Scan for games
scan.intro: Finds new, moved and missing games in your storage locations. Systems with games that you haven’t set are turned on.
scan.noLocations: Add a storage location to scan.
scan.cancelled: Scan cancelled. Systems scanned before cancelling were updated.
scan.failed: The scan stopped because of an error. Check the log for details.

systems.intro: Turn on the systems you play. Each one is looked up as a folder inside your storage locations.

emulators.intro: Add the emulators you use. A preset fills in the launch options, so you only choose the program.
emulators.noProfiles: No profiles yet. Add them from the preset or create a new one.

addDialog.title: Add emulator
addDialog.custom: Custom (you fill in the launch options)

findDialog.title: Find emulators
findDialog.none: No known emulators in that folder.

presetDialog.title: Add profiles from {{name}}
presetDialog.none: Every profile of this preset is already added.

editor.title: Edit profile
editor.name: Name
editor.argsHelp: One argument per row, passed to the emulator exactly as written. Type { to insert a token such as {rom}.
editor.cwdHelp: Leave empty to use the emulator's folder ({emulatorDir}).
editor.coreHelp: Used by the {core} token, e.g. mupen64plus_next_libretro.

editor.previewExample: Example file: choose a game below to use its path.
editor.game: Game for the preview and Test launch
editor.testNeedsGame: Choose a game to run a Test launch.
editor.testing: Running. Close the emulator to see the result.

reason.newerVersion: The settings file was saved by a newer version of NextLevel.
reason.unavailable: NextLevel could not reach its settings service. Your settings file was not changed; restart NextLevel, and if this keeps happening, check the log.

recovery.keep: Your file has not been changed. Choose how to continue:

empty.title: No games yet

details.label: Game details
details.none: Select a game to see its details.

edit.title: Edit details
edit.locked: Edited by you; a scrape keeps this value.

relink.title: Relink {{title}}
relink.intro: {{title}} is missing. Pick the game its file was renamed or moved to.
relink.none: No game in this system matches.
relink.warning: {{title}} keeps its details, favorite and collections and takes the file of {{replacement}}. {{replacement}} is removed from the library.

collections.name: Name
collections.deleteBody: The collection is deleted. Its games stay in the library.
collections.none: No collections yet. Use New collection in the list on the left.

playing.title: Playing {{title}}…
playing.hint: The Library comes back when the game closes.
